findings.reason: Constraints/indexes/column-specific triggers depend on the changed object via the displayed edge kinds.
findings.remediation: Rebuild or transition affected objects with verified order and constraint validation.

findings.reason: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY is forbidden inside a transaction block, including an externally declared single-transaction runner.
findings.remediation: Run the reviewed concurrent index operation outside transaction blocks; inspect invalid-index aftermath on failure.

findings.reason: Regular CREATE INDEX takes SHARE lock and blocks writes. Impact depends on table size, workload and lock waits; no duration is predicted.
findings.remediation: Consider CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY outside transaction blocks; check version/partition restrictions and invalid indexes.

findings.reason: Type transition numeric(12,2) to float8. Conversion compatibility requires type/cast and data verification. PostgreSQL 18 ALTER COLUMN TYPE generally takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE; rewrite/index rebuild depends on cast, typmod and USING expression. Rewrite and lock duration are conditional.
findings.remediation: Design and verify a mapping/replacement column. Check USING, defaults, FKs, views, indexes and actual cast support in a disposable database.
